## About
Affordable Billiard Service, Inc. calls itself Atlanta's oldest and most trusted billiards service company. We move, re-felt, repair and store pool tables, and we also work on snooker and carom tables throughout the Atlanta area, Georgia and the Southeast.
You don't need to know the details of your table before you call. We'll help you figure out what kind of slate you have, the table size, and whether it's a furniture or contemporary style. ABS is also the Official Brunswick Installation Company for Greater Southern Home Recreation.
Customers rate us 5 on Google from 369 reviews.

## Services
- Billiard / Pool Table Moving: We disassemble your slate table, load it into one of our box trucks, then re-install it, level it, seal the seams with beeswax and put the felt back on with staples or glue, whichever the table requires.
- Billiard / Pool Table Re-Felting: We remove the old felt from the bed and rails, check and correct the level, slate plane and slate seams, then install new felt on the bed and rails. Each re-felt comes with a box of chalk to match your felt color. We offer worsted and non-worsted felt for home and commercial tables.
- Gum Rubber cushion replacement on Billiard / Pool Table: We remove the old cushions, sand all the old adherent off the rails and install the new cushions. Sanding the rails is required for a proper install, and new rail cloth is needed.
- Dis-assembly for new floors or flooding: We take the table apart so new floors can go in or water damage can be dealt with. Call for details.
- Pool Table Slate Crating: Call for a complete description of this service.
- Pool Table Repair & Service: Repairs, re-levels and custom felting. Call for a complete description.
- In House Pool Table Moves: Call for a complete description of this service.

## FAQ
Q: I don't know what kind of table I have. Is that a problem?
A: No. We'll gladly help you work out whether your table is 1 or 3 piece slate, its size, and whether it's a furniture or contemporary style.

Q: How far do you travel?
A: We move and service tables throughout the Atlanta area as well as all of Georgia and the Southeast.

Q: Do you offer a discount for law enforcement or military?
A: Yes. We offer a 15% discount for LEO and active duty military. You must mention it when you book.
